$comment: Lighthouse CI config for .github/workflows/site-lighthouse.yml, which runs on each deploy preview of the v2 Netlify site. The URLs are not listed here: the workflow builds them from its hand-maintained LIGHTHOUSE_PATHS and the preview's base URL. Thresholds are withotto.app's (just below the medians of its first real run); raise them as scores improve, and never lower one to pass a run without a reason recorded here. is-crawlable is skipped because Netlify serves every deploy preview with x-robots-tag: noindex, and the v2 site sends noindex everywhere until the switch-over (indexability is enforced by the SEO check over dist/). third-party-cookies is skipped as in withotto.app; this site loads no third-party scripts.
